faqs.question: Can I mix Nutrilite Fiber with beverages other than water?

faqs.question: Are there any precautions or side effects I should be aware of?
faqs.answer: Nutrilite Fiber is generally well-tolerated by most individuals when used as directed. However, as with any dietary supplement, it's crucial to listen to your body and start with a lower dosage to assess your tolerance. Some people may experience mild gastrointestinal discomfort, such as bloating or gas, when initially increasing their fiber intake. These effects typically subside as your body adjusts. If you have any pre-existing medical conditions or are taking medications, it's advisable to consult with a healthcare professional before starting any new supplement regimen.

faqs.question: How much fiber does each serving of Nutrilite Fiber provide?

This significant amount helps you reach the recommended daily intake of 26 grams, making it easier to bridge the fiber gap in your diet.
